one_liner: Turn your phone into a UPI soundbox: hear every payment announced the moment it arrives, with no hardware or monthly rent.
description: UPI Soundbox reads your payment notifications/SMS and announces every credited UPI payment out loud in a clear voice, so shopkeepers stop checking the phone screen. Works with Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM and bank UPI apps as long as you get a payment alert. Choose language, volume and repeat announcement, silent hours, and a custom alert sound. See payment history with date filter and a daily collection summary, and export records. Lightweight and battery friendly for budget phones. It does not access your bank account or store your UPI PIN; it only reads transaction notifications. Set up: install, grant notification/SMS permission, keep the app running in background.
key_features: Announces the amount of every credited UPI payment out loud
Works with Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM and bank UPI apps
No extra hardware, no monthly rental, no installation charge
Language, volume, repeat announcement and silent hours
Payment history with date filter and daily collection summary
Lightweight and battery friendly on budget phones
usp: Your existing smartphone becomes the soundbox: hear the payment, skip the fake-screenshot arguments, pay no rent.
target_audience: Kirana store owners, vegetable and fruit vendors, tea stalls, medical stores, salons, small cafes, delivery partners and auto drivers who accept UPI, in tier-1 to tier-3 cities
claims_to_avoid: naming or insulting a competitor brand or their soundbox
earnings or sales figures as promises
